title: Player browses tournaments
description: Open Tournaments as a player, switch stages, and open an event you are in.

steps.title: Tournaments tab
steps.body: Header Tournaments opens the club event list. Players typically cannot create tournaments.

steps.title: Active list
steps.body: Active, Preregistration, and Completed stages list club events. Open a row to follow results and registration.
steps.resultNote: Active stage shows Tutorial Active Round Robin.

steps.title: Tournament page
steps.body: The event page shows participants and scores. Players follow along; organizers use extra day-of tools here.
steps.resultNote: Opened Tutorial Active Round Robin as a player.
